_comment: Per-repo SDLC settings for CardLab (created by the 001-card-controls design). Commands run from the repo root. auto_merge_feature_prs: null = ask the first time, then true/false.

commands.install: dotnet restore CardLab.sln && npm ci --prefix web && npm ci --prefix tests/e2e
commands.unit: dotnet test tests/CardLab.Domain.Tests && npm test --prefix web -- --run
commands.lint: dotnet format CardLab.sln --verify-no-changes && npm run lint --prefix web && npm run lint --prefix tests/e2e
commands.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix web && npm run typecheck --prefix tests/e2e
commands.build: dotnet build CardLab.sln -warnaserror && npm run build --prefix web

doc_comment_style: C#: XML doc comments (<summary> <param> <returns> <exception>); TypeScript: TSDoc (@param @returns @throws)

env.CARDLAB_TEST_CONNECTION: SQL Server connection string for integration/E2E (default: LocalDB)
